title: parse_time raises ValueError for hh.hhhh with many trailing 9s (microsecond rounds to 1000000)
property: any syntactically valid 'hh.hhh...' time string parses to a time or raises ISO8601Error, never a raw ValueError from time()
expected: A datetime.time just before the next hour (e.g. 00:59:59.999999), as the seconds/minutes branches do via ROUND_FLOOR
evidence: Docstring lists 'hh.hhTZD' with arbitrary decimal fraction as supported; the regex accepts any number of digits. The hour-fraction branch skips the ROUND_FLOOR quantize used by the minute/second branches and then calls to_integral() (rounding), so microsecond can become 1000000.
